_doc: Phrases underlined inside OUTLINED paragraphs only (content/stockPhrases.ts). Only entries with published evidence of over-use in AI-written text; see sources. Matching: case-insensitive, whole word on both sides, spaces match any whitespace, straight or curly apostrophes. A trailing * means 'this stem plus any letters' (delv* = delve, delves, delving). Excluded on purpose: marketing cliches with no measured evidence (game-changer, seamless, unlock, elevate, in today's fast-paced world) and words common in ordinary human writing (key, crucial, vibrant, landscape, additionally). Refresh every 6-12 months: these words drift by model generation (e.g. 'delve' dropped sharply in 2025).
